hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: An even-weighted cycle exists in an undirected network if adding an edge connects two already connected vertices with parity matching.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Maintain connected components with relative edge parity potentials to the root.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: For each query adding an edge between u and v with weight w, check if u and v share the same component and whether cycle weight is even.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Processes incremental edge queries using path compression and parity tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running cycle detection traversals from scratch per edge takes O(q * (V + E)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores parent and potential arrays for n vertices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains potential parity offsets across connected tree components.
